name: WebCloner
author: Bikan

sections.description:
WebCloner is a powerful WordPress migration and import plugin that allows you to import WordPress-compatible content packages generated by the WebCloner platform.

Whether you’re migrating a website, restoring a backup, or cloning content, WebCloner makes the process simple and reliable.

External Service Requirement

This plugin requires a WebCloner account and a content package generated through the WebCloner service.

Website: https://webcloner.tech/

Features

  • Drag-and-drop package upload
  • Import posts, pages, media, and categories
  • Automatically upload media files to the WordPress Media Library
  • Update imported media URLs automatically
  • Import featured images
  • Create and assign categories during import
  • Preserve publication dates where available
  • Import content as drafts for review before publishing
  • AJAX-powered import process with progress tracking
  • Fast and secure WordPress content migration
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “WebCloner”.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Go to Tools → WebCloner.
  6. Upload a supported WebCloner export package and start the import process.
sections.faq:
Where do I get a compatible import package?

Generate and download a WordPress-compatible export package from your WebCloner account.

Does this plugin require a WebCloner account?

Yes. This plugin imports content packages generated by the WebCloner platform.

Can I use this plugin for WordPress migration?

Yes. WebCloner can be used to migrate, restore, and clone WordPress websites using compatible export packages.

Will my existing content be overwritten?

No. Imported content is created as new draft entries. Existing content is not modified.

How long does the import take?

Import time depends on the size of the package and the number of media files included. Progress is displayed during the import process.

What happens if an import is interrupted?

You can restart the import using the same package. The plugin attempts to avoid importing duplicate content where possible.
